source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Each **ORKS PSYKER** unit with this ability gets its **psyker level**, 1 or more, from its abilities, and every **psychic ability** gets its **psychic level**, 1 or more, from its name.

Within a single [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/the-battle-round), an **ORKS PSYKER** unit of yours can use [psychic abilities](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities) whose psychic levels add up to at most its psyker level. For example, a psyker level 3 unit could use:

- 3 abilities of psychic level 1
- an ability of psychic level 1 plus another of psychic level 2
- an ability of psychic level 3
